commitMessage:
Map screen: card-style device list and clearer device card

- Device list items are rounded cards: status-coloured avatar with a
  status dot, bold name, coloured status / last-seen text, subscription
  countdown and chips for speed, engine ON/OFF and battery
- Device card: avatar and status in the header, speed / engine /
  battery chips, address with a pin icon, remaining details, and
  labelled actions (Replay, Command, Edit, Delete, More)
- Speeds default to km/h when no unit is configured (was knots)
